problem:
Consider the line $y=4x+5$ and linear transformation $T$ with matrix representation $T,$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -1 & -3\end{aligned}].
$$

What is the equation of the image of the line under the action of $T?$
worked_solution:
First, notice that the line $y=4x+5$ passes through the points $G(0,5)$ and $H(1,9)$ since the coordinates of both points satisfy the equation.

To find the image of $G$ and $H$ under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing the coordinates of the points:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -1 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ 5 & 9\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -15 & -28\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective image points are ${G}^{′}(0,-15)$ and ${H}^{′}(2,-28).$

Finally, we write the equation of the line that passes through ${G}^{′}$ and ${H}^{′}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y-{y}_{1} & =\frac{{y}_{2}-{y}_{1}}{{x}_{2}-{x}_{1}}(x-{x}_{1}) \\ y-(-15) & =\frac{-28-(-15)}{2-0}(x-0) \\ y+15 & =-\frac{13}{2}x \\ 2y+30 & =-13x \\ 13x+2y+30 & =0\end{aligned}
$$
